blocks.text: The Bravery of Hadhrat Hamza bin Abdil Muttalib (RA)
His Bravery During the Battle of Badr and the Statement of Umayyah bin Khalaf in this Regard

Hadhrat Haarith Taymi narrates that during the Battle of Badr, Hadhrat Hamza bin Abdil Muttalib (RA) distinguished himself by wearing ostrich feathers. One of the Mushrikeen asked, "Who is the man who marks himself with ostrich feathers?" "He is Hamza bin Abdil Muttalib," came the reply. The man then commented, "It was he who carried out all those major offensives against us."[^1]

Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) says that Umayyah bin Khalaf once asked him, "O Abdul Ilaa! Who was the man who marked his chest with ostrich feathers during the Battle of Badr?" "He was the uncle of Rasulullaah ﷺ. He was Hamza bin Abdil Muttalib," replied Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA). Umayyah then commented, "It was he who carried out all those major offensives against us."[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Weeps Bitterly as he Sees the Dead Body of Hadhrat Hamza (RA)

Hadhrat Jaabir bin Abdullaah (RA) narrates that as they were returning from the Battlefield of Uhud, Rasulullaah ﷺ could not find Hadhrat Hamza (RA). Someone said, "I saw him by that tree as he was saying, 'I am the lion of Allaah and the lion of His Rasool ﷺ. O Allaah! I absolve myself from what those people (Abu Sufyaan and the others) have done and I seek pardon from what these people (the Muslims) have done (by causing their own defeat).'" Rasulullaah ﷺ went in that direction and started crying when he caught sight of Hadhrat Hamza (RA)'s forehead. However, when Rasulullaah ﷺ saw how the body of Hadhrat Hamza (RA) was mutilated, he wept uncontrollably. Rasulullaah ﷺ then asked, "Is there no Kafan (burial shroud)?" One of the Ansaar stood up and threw a cloth over the body. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "In the sight of Allaah, Hamza shall be the leader of all martyrs on the Day of Qiyaamah."[^3]
The Martyrdom and Mutilation of Hadhrat Hamza (RA)

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Ja'far bin Amr bin Umayyah Dhamri
blocks.text: Hadhrat Ja'far bin Amr bin Umayyah Dhamri says that it was during the Khilaafah of Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) when he and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Adi bin Khiyaar went out. He then goes on to report a lengthy narration in which he states that when the two of them sat before Hadhrat Wahshi (RA), they asked, "We have come here so that you may relate to us how you managed to martyr Hadhrat Hamza (RA)."
